items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: with Sammy Davis, I went down to Acapulco for two weeks with Sammy Davis, with his show. I was playing trumpet.

ctx.x: Well, you know, now they've got a lot of oil, they're very independent now, you know. But in those days, they depended on the tourists to come through there and a lot of Americans had opened up businesses down there that they were hiring the Mexicans in the businesses. So far as I could see about the political view of it, I don't know.

But, you know, I had a much better time down there in those days than I did this last time, with Sammy Davis, I went down to Acapulco for two weeks with Sammy Davis, with his show. I was playing trumpet.
And in 1952, she went to Argentina and I stayed here in California. And --
